title: Sorting out when La Vida came; closing
summary: Interviewers clarify that La Vida preceded the restaurant, and he has gigged ever since.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: But in the early years you weren't in brass bands, my general. Not a lot, huh? Not a lot, no. Not a regular amount, that's what I'm trying to say. No, no, no. Did we get into the 40s during the war? Where were you doing? Wait, where did that La Vida business come in? That's after you came back from here, after your restaurant and bar here? The La Vida?
The La Vida? Or La Vida? No, the La Vida come in after I come from Bad News.
So it was before you had the restaurant and bar?
And then you went back in the field and you walked after that? That's right, yeah. And you've been gigging around ever since, huh? Ever since. Ever since. Thank you.
